text: There is a long standing issue I'm working at that turned out to have some interesting refactoring suggested by the admins . Does anybody want to pair-code this feat with me? (I also mentioned it in irc). I believe discussing the codebase would be incredibly helpful for me and others wiling to contribute to Lobsters. I'm not a super experienced programmer and I'm not sure yet how to organize this kind of pair-work but thought mentioning it here would be worth a shot and super fun thing to do :D PS: Of course no llm contribution is allowed , just crude old style brain smashing! <3 I'm always down to find time to pair with folks particularly on Ruby stuff. Soonest I could set aside time to pair is Friday, though. If still hunting for folks by then hit me up! (or anybody else reading this that's doing Ruby stuffs that wants to pair hit me up, too!) That is so lovely! Friday is great. I'll pm you to set up time and details. Thank you !
